name: ace from one piece mixed
usage: Read this file before choosing character states or animation clip names.
Animation name is the exact physical clip key. display_name and source_name describe it; aliases are semantic role hints only.
Use resolveCharacterAnimation(manifest, candidates, { state?, direction? }) to resolve the exact stateFolder and clipName across every state.
Prefer an exact user-requested display name or clip name before generic roles such as idle, walk, run, jump, or attack.
CharacterAgent resolves idle, movement, and attack clips across the full manifest and switches state folders automatically.
Rotations are static poses only. Use animator.setPose(...) or characterRotationFrameName(...) for a deliberate static pose; setClip('idle', ...) always means a real animated idle clip.
resolveCharacterAnimation(...) and chooseClip(...) return undefined when no clip matches. Handle that explicitly; never silently replace a missing animation with rotations.
For simple roaming/walking NPCs, use CharacterAgent instead of custom straight-line movement. Its built-in roaming picks walkable targets and follows A* paths around blockers.

For autonomous movement, update movement/pathing before choosing the animation direction. Direction should come from actual movement after collision/sliding, not only the intended path target. Do not cache a facing direction before followPath/collision movement and reuse it for setClip.
If using setDirection as a temporary facing lock, do not call it again after releasing movement/facing control in the same update branch.
CharacterAgent owns the visible sprite as agent.sprite. Do not create a separate scene.add.sprite for the same character.
Keep each character controller or agent in the scene update loop for any movement or animation changes.
When adding behavior to a specific NPC, use explicit references or agent.role/agent.id. Do not infer identity from array position or agent.atlasKey.includes(name); atlas keys are UUID-based.
For dialogue portraits, use states[].portrait.path when present. Build the URL with characterAssetUrl(characterId, path) from the runtime helper.
For portrait lip-sync/vocal animation, use states[].vocal_animation.path when present. It is a grid with moods as rows and visemes as columns.
Use SpriteAnimator(sprite, atlasKey, animations, stateFolder) and animator.setClip(clipName, direction, stateFolder) for resolved clips.

animations.name: attack
animations.description: Facing right, standing tall, draw the flaming fist far back with a strong torso windup, then swing a powerful wide haymaker to the right with a large sweeping arc of orange fire. Brief follow through then return to the original fighting guard. One massive punch, no kicks. Preserve tall full body proportions and planted feet.

animations.description: From fighting guard, wind up and throw a strong straight punch toward the right, extending the flaming fist with a brief fiery trail, then retract the arm and return to the original fighting guard. Keep both feet planted and the character's height consistent. One complete punch, no kicks.

animations.name: idle
animations.description: Facing right and standing tall, cup both hands near the torso and charge a bright concentrated fire orb, pull hands back then thrust both open palms forward to release an enormous horizontal flame blast. Recoil subtly then return to original fighting guard. No punches or kicks. Keep tall proportions and planted feet.

animations.name: idle-7a6f2ebd
animations.description: Standing tall facing right, bend knees slightly gathering flames around both fists, raise both arms outward and upward as a towering crown of fire erupts around the body, then spread the palms releasing the fire outward in a broad fiery wave. Lower arms and return to original fighting guard. No punches or kicks, preserve tall proportions, keep feet anchored.

animations.name: idle-f24ec95e
animations.description: Gentle looping fighting idle, standing tall with subtle breathing and weight shifting. Flames on both fists and feet flicker naturally. Keep full body height and proportions consistent, feet planted, facing right throughout.

animations.name: spell
animations.description: Standing tall facing right, gather flickering fire between open hands, spread the palms and release a bright forward burst of flame, then lower hands and return to the original fighting guard. A flame casting motion, no punching, no kicking. Keep feet planted and full body height consistent.
